I am renting this small plot here on the slopes, so I must be careful with every shilling. The volcanic soil is good but tired from years of maize, so I will buy a little DAP for planting and top-dress with urea if the rains come well during masika. I cannot afford hybrid seed every year, but I kept some improved seed from last season that still gives a better cob than the local one. My children help me weed, and for planting and harvest I will call one neighbor for a few days of kibarua.
